summary: Crescent Private Credit Income Corp, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K on 2026-09-25 declaring September regular and special distributions and updating NAV. Class I and Class S shares receive $0.16500 regular plus $0.04500 special gross; Class S nets $0.19125 after $0.01875 servicing fees. Record date is 2026-09-30 open of business; payment on or about 2026-10-30, cash or DRIP. NAV per share was $26.47 as of 2026-08-31, aggregate NAV ~$590.5M, portfolio fair value ~$970.9M, debt $400.8M, 0.68x leverage. Continuous offering of up to $3.0B continues.
